instruction: Candid documentary photograph, full shot. In a bright, minimalist indoor dance studio with yoga mats stacked on a wall rack, the older dancer in a beige camisole and shorts (R4) stands behind the blonde girl in a beige long-sleeve top and shorts (R5). The older dancer supports the blonde girl by holding her raised right ankle, assisting her in a high side-leg extension stretch. The blonde girl balances on one leg, looking to the right. Bright, even daylight fills the clean space, emphasizing the neutral beige and white palette.
